answer: As of FY2022, Boeing's cost of sales as a percentage of revenues was 94.7% compared with 95.2% in FY2021 and 109.8% in FY2020. This indicates a largely consistent to slightly improving gross margin profile (calculated as 100% minus cost of sales as a percentage of revenues, yielding approximately 5.3% in FY2022, 4.8% in FY2021, and (9.8)% in FY2020). Gross margin remains a useful metric for evaluating Boeing's profitability on products and services, though the company relies heavily on program accounting and long-term contract estimates to recognize revenue and margins over time.
